scope: Adaptive ECC lines530-715 now read fully; full module still incomplete due earlier truncated ranges. Static generation/metadata-caller review, no ECC backend execution.

findings.detail: Missing files, NUL-containing paths and mismatched sizes increment files_skipped then continue before files_corrupted increments. Final return accepts files_corrupted==0, so an all-skipped corpus can report success. Source-level finding; final result does not mean complete verification.
errors_file is opened rb and passed directly to csv.DictReader. Python 3 csv expects text iterator; nonempty supplied error list needs runtime qualification and likely raises before repair.

Generation passes relfilepath str through compatibility b() using Latin-1; non-Latin-1 paths cannot be represented. Correction decodes stored path as Latin-1. Do not generalize text fixture success to arbitrary Unicode filenames.
entry_fields leaves malformed filesize as bytes; caller applies str to it before intra-ECC. That yields Python bytes repr rather than original byte sequence, changing the data offered to repair.

Database and .idx are opened wb before file loop and written separately. No atomic paired publish, rollback, source identity revalidation, per-file failure isolation or cancellation budget visible in this path.

Caller logs uncorrected path/size metadata but does not immediately reject based on fpcorrected/fscorrected; later int/path/size checks determine behavior. Local parser failure is not always isolated as an entry diagnostic.

Generation comments explicitly state stored command parameters are not automatically reloaded. User-supplied decoding parameters must match; file existence/version marker is not codec-compatibility proof.
